purpose: Numerical and molecular-geometry validation of an internal-coordinate bridge representation before any new model training
checks: Native and generated-parent roundtrip; exact fixed atoms; arbitrary proper rigid transform; finite nonzero gradients; independent NumPy evaluation of every touched bond, angle and peptide torsion after nonzero phi/psi changes, using an explicitly reconstructed right endpoint ghost. Report actual endpoint mismatch separately, never claim the assembled chain is closed from ghost geometry.
scope: Original32 training-diagnostic families, no locked-test access. A representation test, not learned capacity, conformational validity or designability. Source parents retain their imperfections. Endpoint, steric and same-refold gates remain necessary.
decision: All numerical tests must pass before specifying a small native-context capacity test. No GPU work or model fitting is performed by this preflight. Do not reopen or re-score the failed Cartesian bridge as a new candidate.
